faqs.question: What is the Hei-Mix S Magnetic Stirrer used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Mix S Magnetic Stirrer is a Heidolph magnetic stirrer used for titrations, biochemical applications, and small fermenter management, stirring volumes of up to 5 litres without heating. faqs.question: Why is the top plate of the Hei-Mix S Magnetic Stirrer white?
faqs.answer: The top plate of the Hei-Mix S Magnetic Stirrer is made of white PVDF, a thermoplastic fluoropolymer, so that colour changes during an application can be tracked precisely. In a titration, the endpoint is a colour change, and a white background makes it far easier to read.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-Mix S Magnetic Stirrer run continuously?

If your method requires a heated plate, select from the Heidolph Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat range instead.

faqs.question: What is the maximum stirring volume of the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer stirs solutions of up to 20 litres. For volumes of 5 litres or less, the Hei-Mix S Magnetic Stirrer may be the more appropriate model.

faqs.question: What is the speed range of the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer has a speed range of 100 to 1,400 rpm, driven by a left-turning EC motor. The range is tuned for controlled, gentle stirring of large volumes rather than fast homogenisation.

faqs.question: What is the soft start on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The soft start on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer brings the stirring rod up to the set speed gradually. This prevents splashing, erratic starts, and the abrupt movement of the stirring rod that can throw it out of coupling and damage a delicate preparation.

faqs.question: What is the Kera-Disk plate on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Kera-Disk plate on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer is a patented Heidolph plate made of aluminium with a ceramic coating, 145 mm in diameter. It is both chemical-resistant and scratch-resistant, which allows it to survive spills and aggressive media.

faqs.question: What is the maximum permissible load on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The maximum permissible load on the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer is 25 kg. This matters in practice, because 20 litres of water alone weighs about 20 kg before the vessel is added, so weigh your filled vessel before selecting the instrument.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The part number of the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer is 506-54100-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this Heidolph configuration in India.

faqs.question: What warranty does the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer carry?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer carries a warranty of at least 10 years after the instrument is registered with Heidolph. Inkarp supports warranty registration at installation.

faqs.question: How loud is the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The acoustic pressure of the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer is less than 50 dB(A). It is the quietest of the unheated Heidolph magnetic stirrers in this range.

faqs.question: What power supply does the Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer require?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 20 L Magnetic Stirrer runs on 230 V at 50/60 Hz with an L+N+PE connection, drawing 25 W in normal operation and 1.7 W in standby. It carries IP42 protection to EN 60529.

features.title: Two Rotary Knobs, Direct Control
features.description: Speed and temperature are set on two rotary knobs against a scale. There is no menu, no display to read, and nothing between you and the two things you came to do.

features.title: PID Heating Control

features.title: Separately Activated Heating

features.title: Optical Residual Heat Indicator
features.description: The indicator remains lit while the plate is above 50 °C. The most common burn on a hot plate stirrer happens after the heat has been switched off, and this is the feature that prevents it.

features.title: Large Safety Gap

features.title: Die-Cast Aluminium Housing

faqs.question: What is the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer is Heidolph's entry-level hot plate magnetic stirrer, used for heated stirring, dissolution, reaction work, and sample preparation. Speed and temperature are set directly on two rotary knobs, to maximum values of 1,400 rpm and 300 °C.

faqs.question: What is the maximum temperature of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer heats from 20 °C to 300 °C. The temperature is set on a rotary knob against a scale, and is held under PID control.

faqs.question: What is the heating power of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer delivers 800 W of heating power on a 230 V supply, which is the supply used in India. On a 115 V supply the heating power is 600 W.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer overshoot the set temperature?
faqs.answer: No, the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer uses PID control, which brings liquids to the target temperature quickly and without overshoot. Overshoot is what spoils a temperature-sensitive reaction, so the control algorithm is designed to prevent it.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer control the temperature of the liquid?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer controls the temperature of the plate. To control and measure the temperature of the medium itself, add the EKT Hei-Con temperature control unit, which extends the indication and measurement range to -80 to 350 °C.

faqs.question: What is the speed range of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer?

body: (Section swapped. Replaces "Performance and Utility Planning". Justification in Author Notes.)

Heating performance and temperature control on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Magnetic Stirrer are governed by 800 W of heating power at 230 V, PID control to 300 °C, the rapid heat transfer of the Kera-Disk plate, and optional probe control through the EKT Hei-Con.

Two numbers decide whether a hot plate stirrer is any good. How fast it reaches temperature, and whether it stops there. The Core answers the first with 800 W and a plate designed for rapid heat transfer, and the second with PID control that does not overshoot.

One limit is worth being clear about. The Core sets and holds the plate temperature. If your method depends on the temperature of the medium, you need the EKT Hei-Con temperature control unit, which reads the medium directly and extends the range to -80 to 350 °C.

features.title: Digital LCD Display
features.description: Temperature is set as a number on a display, not as a position on a printed scale. Between two instruments that both heat to 300 °C, this is the difference between a method you can write down and a method you have to demonstrate.

features.title: FAST and PRECISE Heating Modules

features.title: Optional Pt1000 Temperature Sensor
features.description: With the external Pt1000 sensor, the instrument controls the temperature of the medium rather than the temperature of the plate, to an accuracy of ±0.2 K plus the sensor tolerance. If your result depends on what the liquid is at, this is not an accessory, it is the point.

features.title: Dynamic Rotary Knobs
features.description: The knobs respond to how fast you turn them. A slow turn makes a small, precise change; a fast turn makes a large one. You get fine control and quick travel from the same control, without a menu.

features.title: Locking Function
features.description: Settings can be locked, which prevents an accidental knock or a passing colleague from changing a method that is already running. On a shared bench this is the feature that protects a long run.

features.title: Illuminated Keys and Patented LED Ring
features.description: The keys and knobs light to show which functions are active, and the patented LED ring system makes the state of the instrument readable at a glance. The design is built to minimise operating errors, not just to look modern.

features.title: Residual Heat Indicator
features.description: A visual indicator warns of residual heat above 50 °C. The most common burn on a hot plate happens after the run, on a plate that looks exactly like a cold one.

features.title: Heating to 300 °C at 800 W
features.description: On a 230 V supply the instrument delivers 800 W of heating power across a 20 to 300 °C range, under PID control.

features.title: Patented Kera-Disk Plate
features.description: The 145 mm Kera-Disk plate is anodized aluminium, chemical-resistant and scratch-resistant, and it transfers heat rapidly. It survives the spills that scar a lesser plate.

Heating performance and temperature control on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + Magnetic Stirrer are governed by 800 W of heating power at 230 V, the FAST and PRECISE heating modules, PID control across 20 to 300 °C, and the optional Pt1000 sensor with ±0.2 K measurement accuracy.
Every hot plate stirrer trades speed against overshoot. Heat hard and you sail past the setpoint. Heat gently and you wait. The Core+ does not resolve that trade-off, it hands it to you as a switch.
FAST drives the liquid to temperature in the shortest time, which is what you want when the target is well below anything that would spoil the sample.
PRECISE approaches the setpoint with little to no overshoot, which is what you want when a few degrees past the target ruins the run.

The second decision is what you are measuring. Without the sensor, the instrument controls the plate. With the optional external Pt1000, it controls the medium, to an accuracy of ±0.2 K plus the sensor tolerance, across an indication range of 15 to 325 °C.

features.title: RS232 and USB B Interfaces for Automated Control
features.description: The RS232 and USB B ports allow the instrument to be controlled through the Hei-PROCESS solution, which is what turns a bench stirrer into a step in an automated laboratory process rather than a manual interruption in one.

features.title: Standalone Data Logging via USB A
features.description: The front USB A port logs data directly to a USB stick, with no software, no network, and no IT approval required. For a laboratory that needs a record but cannot get a computer onto the bench, this is the whole answer.

features.title: USB C and the Electric e-Lift
features.description: The USB C port connects the Heidolph e-Lift, an electric lab jack designed specifically for this instrument. Power and data both travel over the one cable, and the lift is driven from the arrow buttons on the stirrer itself.

features.title: Automatic Vessel Lowering on Error
features.description: With the e-Lift attached, the lab jack lowers automatically in response to an error such as overtemperature, or on a defined event such as a timer expiring. An instrument that can remove the sample from the heat without a person present is a different proposition from one that cannot.

features.title: Three Heating Modules
features.description: FAST heats liquids to the target in the shortest time. PRECISE and PRECISE+ approach the target without overshoot, for optimal protection of sensitive samples. Three modes means you choose per method, not once at purchase.

features.title: Heating to 350 °C
features.description: The Ultimate heats from 20 °C to 350 °C, with a setting accuracy of 1 K. That is fifty degrees beyond the Core and the Core+, which stop at 300 °C.

features.title: Dual Pt1000 Sensor Support
features.description: The instrument accepts the Pt1000 temperature sensor and the dual Pt1000 sensor. The dual sensor allows individual temperature profiles to be created simultaneously, which improves the precision and reproducibility of an experiment.

features.title: 0.1 K Measurement Resolution
features.description: Temperature is resolved to 0.1 K with an external Pt1000 sensor, at an accuracy of ±0.2 K plus the sensor tolerance. The Core+ resolves to 1 K.

features.title: Automatic Stir Bar Detector
features.description: The instrument detects the stir bar automatically, for optimal mixing. A stir bar that has decoupled and stopped turning is one of the commonest silent failures on a magnetic stirrer, and this is the feature that catches it.

features.title: Bidirectional Stirring and Three-Stage Start-Up
features.description: Rotation direction is adjustable, clockwise or counterclockwise, and start-up behaviour has a three-stage setting. Both matter where the medium or the vessel geometry makes coupling difficult.

features.title: Speed Set to 1 rpm
features.description: Speed runs from 100 to 1,400 rpm with a setting accuracy of 1 rpm, on a left and right turning EC motor.

features.title: Safety Distance and Residual Heat Indicator
features.description: A large safety distance separates the heating plate from the control panel, and a visual residual heat indicator warns above 50 °C. The burn on a hot plate usually happens after the run, not during it.

features.title: Patented Kera-Disk Plate
features.description: The 145 mm Kera-Disk plate is anodized aluminium, chemical-resistant and scratch-proof, and it delivers the fastest heating times in the range.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer is Heidolph's connected hot plate magnetic stirrer, used for automated laboratory processes, data-logged heated methods, and unattended heated runs. It heats to 350 °C, offers three selectable heating modules, and provides RS232 and USB interfaces for control and logging.

faqs.question: What interfaces does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer have?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer has four interfaces. RS232 and USB B allow control through the Hei-PROCESS solution, a front USB A port enables standalone data logging to a USB stick, and a USB C port connects the electric Heidolph e-Lift lab jack.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer log data?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer logs data directly to a USB stick through its front USB A port. No software, computer, or network connection is required.

faqs.question: What is the maximum temperature of the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer heats from 20 °C to 350 °C, with a setting accuracy of 1 K. This is 50 °C beyond the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core and Core +, which both stop at 300 °C.

faqs.question: What are the three heating modules on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer has three selectable heating modules. FAST heats quickly. PRECISE and PRECISE + provide exact temperature control without overshoot, for optimal protection of sensitive samples.

faqs.question: What is the e-Lift on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The e-Lift is an electric lab jack designed specifically for the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer. It connects by USB C, which carries both power and data, and is controlled from the arrow buttons on the stirrer. It lowers automatically in response to an error such as overtemperature, or on a defined event such as a timer expiring.

faqs.question: Does the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer detect the stir bar?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer has an automatic stir bar detector, which supports optimal mixing and catches a stir bar that has decoupled and stopped turning.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core + and the Core Ultimate?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate adds RS232, USB A, USB B and USB C interfaces, standalone data logging, e-Lift compatibility, a third heating module (PRECISE +), dual Pt1000 sensor support, automatic stir bar detection, bidirectional stirring, 0.1 K measurement resolution, and a 350 °C temperature range. The Core + heats to 300 °C, has an LCD display, and has no interfaces.

faqs.question: What temperature sensors work with the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Ultimate Magnetic Stirrer is compatible with the Pt1000 temperature sensor and the dual Pt1000 sensor. The dual sensor allows individual temperature profiles to be created simultaneously, improving precision and reproducibility.

body: (Section swapped. Replaces "Performance and Utility Planning". Justification in Author Notes.)

Safety limits and temperature control on the Hei-Plate Mix 'n' Heat Core Expert Magnetic Stirrer are delivered through a settable ΔT between set and actual temperature, a digital limitation of the plate temperature, three heating modes, an automatic stir bar detector, and dual Pt1000 sensing.
Two limits, and they guard against two different accidents.

The ΔT limit guards against the sample. In a highly exothermic reaction, the sample makes its own heat. You set the maximum allowable difference between the temperature you asked for and the temperature actually reached, and the instrument stops contributing to a runaway. This is the feature that makes unsupervised operation a considered decision rather than a gamble.

The digital plate limit guards against the plate. For a liquid with a low ignition temperature, or a material with a low melting point, the hazard is not the setpoint, it is the surface. A digital ceiling on the plate temperature caps it directly.

The stir bar detector guards against the bump. A stalled stir bar in a heated liquid leads to delayed boiling. The detector confirms the bar is turning even when irregularities occur, and minimises that danger.
